name: Musashi Auto Parts-Michigan
old_description: Providing reliable, high quality, low cost products and solutions to our global customers.
about:
Musashi Auto Parts-Michigan operates from Battle Creek, Michigan, as part of the Musashi Americas network. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but it functions as a manufacturing arm of the global Musashi group, which emphasizes "Simple, Sturdy and Consistent Sincerity" as its guiding principle under leadership such as Haru Otsuka.

The facility specializes in near-net-shape aluminum and steel forgings that reduce downstream machining, and runs in-house machining to produce finished components. Its product portfolio includes differential assemblies, planetary assemblies, camshafts, and newer electrified-driveline technologies such as the TractionTech Locker™ electromagnetic differential and the TractionTech Disconnect™ system for ICE, hybrid, and battery-electric all-wheel-drive applications.

Musashi serves the automotive industry, supplying powertrain components to global vehicle manufacturers. Its customer base includes OEMs seeking integrated production systems and robust engineering support for both conventional and electrified propulsion platforms.

The company positions itself on reliable, high-quality, low-cost solutions delivered through a global manufacturing network, with a focus on engineering innovation that reduces weight and complexity in driveline systems.
